messages:
Nora Patel: opened PR to clarify Troubleshooting -> Error reference for 429s/timeouts/context truncation. Found an example that encourages parsing partial stream chunks. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9410
Sam Patel: noted. I'll fix anchors and markdownlint. We should add a tiny decision note: when to resume a stream vs fallback.
Cheng Li: for the streaming repro, I'll paste a minimal curl/cut-socket example and a short Python v2 snippet showing catching StreamError and checking e.status_code == 429.
Cheng Li: ```bash
# start stream then kill client to simulate partial stream + delayed 429
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"model":"rwd-light-1","input":"LONG_PROMPT"}'
# kill after a few chunks to mimic disconnect
```
Sam Patel: I'll push link fixes. Also update cross-links to use #handling-429-in-streams anchor.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9410  CI queued
Nora Patel: add a short note under Context limits to check response metadata for `truncated` flags and to prefer numeric status checks + Retry-After handling instead of parsing partial JSON.
Cheng Li: ran the curl repro in staging, reproduced stream->429. Added clarifying line: resume only when idempotent + resume token present; otherwise trim and retry or switch model.
Sam Patel: pushed anchor and lint fixes, CI passed :white_check_mark:. Merging after squash.
